001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory;
002
003import org.bukkit.block.Block;
004import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
007
008import java.util.Comparator;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
011import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
012
013/**
014 * Stores the block-container providers available to QuickShop.
015 *
016 * <p>The highest priority provider wins. Providers with equal priority retain registration order,
017 * making resolution deterministic across repeated lookups.</p>
018 */
019public final class ShopContainerProviderRegistry {
020
021  private static final Comparator<Entry> RESOLUTION_ORDER = Comparator
022          .comparingInt((Entry entry) -> entry.provider().priority())
023          .reversed()
024          .thenComparingLong(Entry::sequence);
025
026  private final List<Entry> providers = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
027  private final AtomicLong sequence = new AtomicLong();
028
029  /**
030   * Registers a provider owned by a plugin.
031   *
032   * @param plugin the provider owner
033   * @param provider the provider
034   */
035  public void register(@NotNull final Plugin plugin, @NotNull final ShopContainerProvider provider) {
036
037    providers.add(new Entry(plugin, provider, sequence.getAndIncrement()));
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Removes every provider registered by a plugin.
042   *
043   * @param plugin the provider owner
044   */
045  public void unregister(@NotNull final Plugin plugin) {
046
047    providers.removeIf(entry -> entry.plugin().equals(plugin));
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Resolves the provider responsible for a block.
052   *
053   * @param block the candidate block
054   * @return the selected provider, or {@code null} when unsupported
055   */
056  @Nullable
057  public ShopContainerProvider resolve(@NotNull final Block block) {
058
059    return providers.stream()
060            .sorted(RESOLUTION_ORDER)
061            .map(Entry::provider)
062            .filter(provider -> provider.supports(block))
063            .findFirst()
064            .orElse(null);
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Finds the provider associated with an inventory-wrapper manager.
069   *
070   * @param manager the wrapper manager
071   * @return the provider, or {@code null} when none is registered
072   */
073  @Nullable
074  public ShopContainerProvider find(@NotNull final InventoryWrapperManager manager) {
075
076    return providers.stream()
077            .sorted(RESOLUTION_ORDER)
078            .map(Entry::provider)
079            .filter(provider -> provider.getInventoryWrapperManager() == manager
080                    || provider.getInventoryWrapperManager().equals(manager))
081            .findFirst()
082            .orElse(null);
083  }
084
085  private record Entry(
086          @NotNull Plugin plugin,
087          @NotNull ShopContainerProvider provider,
088          long sequence
089  ) {
090  }
091}
